credit: NASA / JPL, Mars Pathfinder rover engineering data, PDS Imaging Node
source: Mars Pathfinder rover engineering telemetry in engineering units, sols 1 to 78
citation: Sojourner traverse. Data NASA / JPL, compiled and published by azmth.space, https://azmth.space/mars/data
compilation: Compiled by azmth.space: the published layers joined into one ordered path, every vertex dated to the sol it was driven on, drives and waypoints indexed against it, and sourced moments merged. The coordinates are the mission's own.
datum: Mars 2000 sphere, radius 3,396,190 m; lander-relative telemetry, no elevations
note: This is the rover's own dead reckoning in the lander frame, anchored at the Carl Sagan Memorial Station. 73 of the 78 sols are in the archive and ten are missing. The archived labels do not define which way the frame's axes point, so the path's orientation relative to north is not established. The odometry counts travel inside a sol only, so the missing sols are not read as driving.

moments.title: Airbags down in Ares Vallis
moments.text: Pathfinder hit Ares Vallis inside an airbag cocoon at 16:56:55 UTC, rolled for about two minutes and came to rest about 19 km southwest of the target, tilted about 2.5 degrees, with Sojourner folded on a petal.
moments.sourceLabel: NASA PDS: Mars Pathfinder mission description

moments.title: Six wheels on Mars
moments.text: An airbag draped over the rover's petal held up the drive off, and the petal had to be closed part way and reopened. Sojourner was deployed at 05:37 UTC on 6 July, the first wheels to drive on Mars.
moments.sourceLabel: NASA PDS: Mars Pathfinder mission description

moments.title: Barnacle Bill, the first rock read on Mars
moments.text: Sojourner set its alpha proton X-ray spectrometer against Barnacle Bill, a rock named for its rough surface. A full read takes about ten hours. The read placed it among the silica rich basaltic andesites.
moments.sourceLabel: NASA Science: Sojourner's APXS studies Barnacle Bill

moments.title: Yogi, the second rock
moments.text: The spectrometer sat on Yogi over sols 8, 9 and 10, the second rock Sojourner read. Yogi came back low in quartz and more primitive than Barnacle Bill, closer to the common basalts found on Earth.

moments.title: Scooby Doo scraped with a wheel
moments.text: Sojourner scraped the top off the pink rock Scooby Doo with a wheel and read the fresh patch. Its composition matched the drift soil around it, so NASA reads it as a chemically cemented hardpan under much of the site.
moments.sourceLabel: NASA Science: rock and soil types at the Pathfinder landing site

moments.title: The patch that stopped the resets
moments.text: The lander's computer had reset itself four times, on 5, 10, 11 and 14 July, disrupting operations each time. On sol 17 the flight team sent up a software update to correct the sequences that were causing it.
moments.sourceLabel: JPL Mars Pathfinder mission status, 21 July 1997 (sol 17, archived)

moments.title: Digging into Mermaid Dune
moments.text: Sojourner reached the drift the team called Mermaid Dune and set the spectrometer on its surface. The next sol it cut ruts with its wheels and imaged two excavations, bringing buried sediment up for the cameras.
moments.sourceLabel: NASA PDS: Mars Pathfinder rover event log (H. J. Moore)

moments.title: Prime mission complete, 52 m driven
moments.text: JPL called the 30 day prime mission finished on 3 August with the rover healthy, 52 m on its odometer and 384 pictures returned. Everything Sojourner did after this counted as extended mission.
moments.sourceLabel: JPL: Mars Pathfinder Concludes Primary Science Mission

moments.title: Aiming for Shark, parked on Wedge
moments.text: Sol 47 returned very little data. The end of day images showed that Sojourner had missed Shark and was sitting with its wheels on top of the rock Wedge instead.
moments.sourceLabel: NASA PDS: Mars Pathfinder rover event log (H. J. Moore)

moments.title: The battery dies at Half Dome
moments.text: The rover's battery gave out in the very early morning of sol 56, at Half Dome in the Rock Garden. Sojourner worked through the daylight anyway, redeploying the spectrometer and starting a second read of Half Dome.
moments.sourceLabel: NASA PDS: Mars Pathfinder rover event log (H. J. Moore)

moments.title: The farthest point from the lander
moments.text: At noontime on sol 75 Sojourner stood more than 12 m from the lander, a mission record, out in the swale it had been imaging. It had photographed the rock Chimp from 0.25 m the sol before.

moments.title: Last contact
moments.text: The last successful data transmission finished at 3:23 a.m. PDT on 27 September, sol 83. The rover had just completed a spectrometer study of a rock called Chimp, to the left of the Rock Garden.
moments.sourceLabel: NASA Science: Mars Pathfinder winds down after phenomenal mission
